name: Saree
covers: sarees of every weave: Banarasi, Kanjeevaram, Chanderi, Tussar, cotton, georgette, organza, printed and embroidered sarees
checks: the border: its width, motif and colour, along the whole length
the pallu: its motif, colour and how densely it is woven or printed
the body: its colour, and the size and spacing of any butis or print
the zari or embroidery: its metal tone (gold, silver, copper) and where it sits
the fabric's sheen and fall (silk shine, cotton matte, organza sheer)
shot: Full length or three-quarter, so the drape, the border and the pallu all read; the pallu spread or falling over the shoulder toward the camera; the blouse simple and matching unless the user says otherwise.
poses: standing, pallu falling over the left shoulder
pallu held open in one hand to show its motif
seated on steps, the border spread around her
